main_text.l: VATICINII
IMPLEMENTUM
DEMONSTRATUM.
NOtandum interim Prophetam hic loqui, ac
si jam tum adessent, quae præ foribus erant;
quia in visione prophetica illi dabatur intueri
secutura, ac si inspiceret coram, dum videbat
ea in divino repræsentamine oblata. Proin, quid secutum
fuerit ex historiâ recensendum est, ut visionis cum
e-ventu constet analogia.
I. Inspiciamus regis Chaldæorum conatus: & occur-
ret 1. plusquam una expeditio, quarum prior imaginem
refert piscaturæ, hamo inescantis gentes. Id factum, quan-do
Ægyptio in terras suas repulso, cæteras nationes in fœdus
recepit, ut penso tributo ejus imperium,agnoscant: ita
in initio arte eas allexit, dum eas clementer habuit, & poten-
tioris defensionis oblatione inescavit. Altera vero ex-
peditio speciem habuit piscaturæ, fagenâ populos attra-
hentis, ex quibus novas fecit colonias: quale quid fa-
ctum, cum Jechoniam[?] regem, cum matre, regni pro-
ceribus, populique flore, Babyloniam abduxit, tenuio-
ribus tantum ex plebe infimi Hierosolymis relictis,
quorum aut ætas victori fastidio erat, aut imbecillitas
servitio inutilis solum exercendis colendisque agris vide-
batur. Hac fagenâ evacuatâ tertia secuta est expeditio,
quando piscaturam repetens quasi everriculo terram Ju-
daicam

page.notes: Initial N is a large woodcut letter, joined to "Notandum" as "NOtandum". The numeral "1." after "occurret" is set in the text line, so it is kept as printed. "Jechoniam" is doubtful: the scan is unclear and it may read differently. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, as printed. Printed "imperium,agnoscant" lacks a space after the comma, which is kept as printed.
